name: Apple~
description: Wrinkled, but sound and sweet.

name: Handful~ of Dried Fruits
description: Fruit roughly chopped and sun-dried, prepared as marching rations for the rangers of Ithilien.

name: Scrap~ of Flesh
description: A grey-looking piece of dried flesh of you dare not guess what creature. You would have to be desperate to eat this.
effect: random:5; nourish:4000; nourish:4000; nourish:2000; set_food:200; set_food:200

name: Slice~ of Meat
description: A thick slice of pork, salted to keep it from spoiling. It is very filling.

name: Honey-cake~
description: The Beornings are renowned as the best bakers among men, and their honey-cakes are deservedly prized. Made of wheat flour with nuts and honey and twice baked, they will sustain you through a long march.

name: Piece~ of Elvish Waybread
description: Food of the elves is always good; their waybread is no exception. These thin cakes are wrapped in leaves and keep their tastiness for months.

name: Flask~ of Whisky
description: It raises your spirits.

name: Pint~ of Fine Wine
description: A fine way to wash down some otherwise unappetising rations.

name: Sip~ of Miruvor
description: Just a little of this warm and fragrant liquor gives you fresh hope and vigour.

name: Swig~ of Orcish Liquor
description: This is a dirty brown color; you don't trust it.

name: Draught~ of the Ents
description: This looks like pure water, but its scent reminds you of the smell of a distant wood borne from afar by a cool breeze at night.

name: Fast Recovery
effect: heal:30:0; cure:stun; cure:cut; cure:poisoned; cure:blind; nourish:1000

name: Vigor
effect: restore_stat:str; restore_stat:int; restore_stat:wis; restore_stat:dex; restore_stat:con; nourish:1000

name: Clear Mind
effect: restore_mana; cure:confused; cure:image; cure:afraid; timed:oppose_conf:7d7+50; nourish:1000

name: Terror
description: It allows you to run for your life.

name: Stoneskin
description: Its poison turns your skin to stone, albeit briefly.

name: Sprinting
description: It hastes you for a while, but then makes you slower for a while afterward.

name: Purging
description: It makes you very hungry but otherwise healthy.

name: Shadows
description: It makes you very stealthy for a short while.

name: Tulwar~
description: A wider-bladed cousin of the shamshir, with less of a curve.

name: Scimitar~
description: A long sabre with an extreme curve to the blade.

name: Katana~
description: A slightly curved long-handled slashing sword with a single-edged blade and a chisel tip.

name: Executioner's Sword~
description: A giant, curved blade designed to cleave the head cleanly from the body.

name: Blade~ of Chaos
description: This inconstant weapon revels in disorder, hacking and slashing your foes with bloodthirsty glee.

name: Ball-and-Chain~
description: A weighty iron ball, suspended by a chain from a sturdy oaken handle.

name: Two-Handed Great Flail~
description: Two great bars of wood connected by a massive chain, needing two hands to properly wield.

name: Quarterstaff~
description: Six feet of oak which can be wielded in both hands to give a drubbing or block one.

name: Throwing Hammer~
description: A short-handled iron hammer that can strike hard when thrown.

name: Maul~
description: A long-handled hammer with a heavy head.

name: Great Hammer~
description: A mighty hammer with a massive head designed to crush and stun.

name: Mace~ of Disruption
description: A giant's weapon, enchanted with shattering power that breaks bones, bodies, and spirit.

name: Throwing Axe~
description: A short-handled hatchet, balanced for throwing. A classic skirmisher's weapon.

name: Beaked Axe~
description: A narrow axe head opposed by a crow's beak for penetrating armour.

name: Broad Axe~
description: A simple, single-bladed war axe capable of chopping though limbs or armour.

name: Battle Axe~
description: A double-bladed axe. Very popular among Dwarves.

name: Lochaber Axe~
description: A long shaft with a long narrow blade.

name: Great Axe~
description: An enormous two-handed battle axe, carried by Dwarven champions, who compete to see who can cleave the most orc heads.

name: Scythe~
description: The long crescent blade stands out from the handle of this polearm, and it is swung with two hands to harvest grain or blood.

name: Glaive~
description: A reinforced wooden pole eight feet long, topped by a massive knife blade that can be used to thrust or chop.

name: Lance~
description: A massive, tapered spear used primarily from horseback.

name: Scythe~ of Slicing
description: A reaper's weapon, the long blade almost hums in anticipation of the blood it will spill.

name: Lucerne Hammer~
description: A long pole with a three- or four-pronged head balanced by a long spike.

name: Heavy Crossbow~
description: This arbalest is so powerful it has to be reinforced with metal and requires a crank to be cocked.

name: Seeker Arrow~
description: It can be shot with a bow.

name: Mithril Arrow~
description: It can be shot with a bow.

name: Seeker Bolt~
description: It can be shot with a crossbow.

name: Mithril Bolt~
description: It can be shot with a crossbow.

name: Rounded Pebble~
description: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.

name: Mithril Shot~
description: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.

name: Shovel~
description: A compact and sturdy spade.

name: Pick~
description: A heavy mining tool with a long, slightly curved head that tapers to chisel points on both ends.

name: Mattock~
description: A digging tool with a broad horizontal blade balanced by a smaller vertical blade. Used as a weapon of war by dwarves.

name: Pair~ of Iron Shod Boots
description: A set of sturdy leather boots strengthened with iron that will last many weary miles.

name: Pair~ of Steel Shod Boots
description: A set of double-lined leather boots, with toes and heels reinforced with steel.

name: Pair~ of Mithril Shod Boots
description: The enduring dwarves make the finest footgear known, and they march in it for endless miles without wearying.

name: Pair~ of Ethereal Slippers
description: Fine quality elvish slippers, hard-wearing but apparently weightless.

name: Steel Helm~
description: This great helm covers the head and shoulders with plates of steel and a curtain of mail.

name: Iron Crown~
description: A plain band of iron, crowned with iron spikes. It is a tyrant's symbol.

name: Golden Crown~
description: An elegant golden circlet, with slender spines thrusting upward. It looks like it should be resting over the brow of a king.

name: Jewel Encrusted Crown~
description: An elaboratedly decorated crown of massive gold, studded with a rainbow of gems and jewels; worthy of a High King.

name: Robe~
description: A practical garment of thick wool or velvet, draping from neck to heels.

name: Studded Leather Armour~
description: A cuirass of pliable leather studded with metal rivets.

name: Leather Scale Mail~
description: A tunic and skirt sewn with thick, overlapping scales of hardened leather.

name: Augmented Chain Mail~
description: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, strategically reinforced at vital locations with a second layer of chain, all over a layer of heavy padding.

name: Bar Chain Mail~
description: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, reinforced around the shoulders with segmented plates of steel, all over a layer of heavy padding.

name: Metal Brigandine Armour~
description: A stiff suit of armour composed of small metal plates sewn to an inner layer of heavy canvas, and covered with a second layer of cloth.

name: Partial Plate Armour~
description: A steel corselet and vambraces over a skirt and leggings of chain.

name: Metal Lamellar Armour~
description: This unusual armour is a surprisingly light suit of laced and overlapping metal plates.

name: Full Plate Armour~
description: A full suit of carefully fitted plates, with hinged joints backed by chain, and light padding underneath.

name: Ribbed Plate Armour~
description: A full suit of finely fitted metal armour consisting of steel plates reinforced ridging.

name: Mithril Chain Mail~
description: This wondrous suit of fine-linked chain shimmers as though of pure silver.

name: Mithril Plate Mail~
description: A shimmering suit of true-silver, forged long ago by dwarven smiths of legend. It gleams with purest white as you gaze upon it.

name: Adamantite Plate Mail~
description: An exquisite suit of nearly impenetrable adamantite.

name: Elven Cloak~
description: A mantle made of curious silken material by the Galadrim that wondrously takes on the hues and shapes of its surroundings.

name: Ethereal Cloak~
description: This unearthly, completely transparent body mantle folds and drapes in iridescent patterns around you. It weighs absolutely nothing.

name: Set~ of Mithril Gauntlets
description: A set of gauntlets wrought of light, shining mithril.

name: Set~ of Caestus
description: An ancient battle glove designed for hand-to-hand fighting. Its layered leather thongs are enhanced for combat by bloody-looking spikes.

name: Set~ of Alchemist's Gloves
description: Highly protective gloves designed for an alchemist's elemental magics.

name: Small Metal Shield~
description: A round shield of wood reinforced with metal rims and central disk.

name: Large Metal Shield~
description: An oval shield of wood covered by leather and rimmed with metal. A large iron shield boss offers excellent hand protection.

name: Knight's Shield~
description: A kite-shaped shield with rounded corners that covers the wearer from chest to toe, emblazoned with heraldic symbols.

name: Mithril Shield~
description: A shield of purest white, made of mithril.

name: Flames
activationText: fires a ball of fire (80) and grants temporary resistance to fire

name: Acid
activationText: fires a ball of acid (70) and grants temporary resistance to acid

name: Ice
activationText: fires a ball of frost (75) and grants temporary resistance to frost

name: Lightning
activationText: fires a ball of lightning (85) and grants temporary resistance to lightning

description: It boosts your to-dam value.

name: Accuracy
description: It boosts your to-hit value.

name: Slaying
description: It boosts your to-hit and to-dam values.

name: Open Wounds
activationText: heals 40 hit points, cures blindness, heals cuts and cures confusion

name: Black Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of utterly black scales, against which no metal or wood can rest.

name: Blue Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales as blue as sapphires, emitting eerie sparks and coronas as you move about in it.

name: White Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales, coldly gleaming in frosty white. A shiver runs down through your spine even as you look at it.

name: Red Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales, with all the reds of every fire ever lit. The scar tissue from an old burn aches as you put this armour on.

name: Green Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales, glistening in sickly green, out from which falls the skeleton of a rat who touched it and died in agony.

name: Multi-Hued Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales that throbs with angry energies; it takes all your energy to master the Elements fighting an endless war trapped inside.
activationText: lets you breathe acid, lightning, fire, frost or poison (250)

name: Shining Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales shining like a beacon of Light even as it greedily sucks the energy away from everything that glows into Dark insatiate.
activationText: lets you breathe light or darkness (200)

name: Law Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales in stern blue and silver. You feel the slightest tremor as you touch it, like massed trumpets heard and cyclones felt from afar.
activationText: lets you breathe sound or shards (230)

name: Gold Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales in mirror-like gold. You hear nothing unusual as you wear this armour, yet your ears ache as though in the midst of a cacophony.

name: Chaos Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales that ripples and twists through every color and shape imaginable as you stare in fascination.
activationText: lets you breathe chaos or disenchantment (220)

name: Balance Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit of scales. Featureless grey to casual inspection, yet a closer look reveals patterns within patterns of iridescence that throb with leashed energies bound as though by chains of adamant.
activationText: lets you breathe sound, shards, chaos or disenchantment (250)

name: Power Dragon Scale Mail~
description: A suit with scales of every color, surrounded in a nimbus of perfectly untrammelled yet inextricably intermingled and utterly mastered powers elemental and ethereal.
